initial_question: What consequential valuable possibility has become achievable through capable agents, public knowledge, constructed instruments or a new coordination arrangement, which existing organizations are not adequately equipped to pursue?
starting_domains: A useful capability unavailable because evidence lives in incompatible representations
Missing measurements or instruments needed to unlock neglected productive work
Scientific or engineering combinations whose outputs cannot be bought from existing workflows
Public-interest or commercial needs left unserved by current tools despite accessible inputs
Constructed products with falsifiable performance, beyond faster administration or existing contracts
known_exclusions: generic faster solvers or renamed workflows
ordinary reuse libraries as a discovery headline
currently active AGI Alpha scientific-model reuse, ecology-demand, satellite-observation or report-reconstruction lanes
The six round1 ideas as generic contracting/coordination products
Proof of novelty from no search hit
Renaming prior art as new AGI capability
available_resources: Public primary sources and documented frontier reasoning/tool capabilities as of 2026-10-27
Python and Node execution, scientific computing and local cryptographic fixtures
No paid customers, licensed private data, physical laboratory, paid model API campaign or live ENS/on-chain action assumed
requested_output: Three diverse opportunities, with beneficiary, missing useful outcome, specific prior-art gap, enabling change, discovered connection, minimal construction/falsifier, commercial mechanism and successor inheritance. Rank and select one provisionally.
learning_from_round1: Six consequential coordination opportunities were generated, but current primary prior art anticipates most mechanisms. The original records and probes remain preserved. Pooling, assurance contracts, concurrent closing, generic marketplaces and scheduling cannot alone earn the next discovery claim.

required_candidate_test: For each candidate name a concrete useful output, the existing approach unable to supply it under a specific restriction, and the constructed mechanism that removes that restriction. Search against the strongest competitor and cite an explicit residual gap. Newly affordable execution may matter, but a generic faster consultant is insufficient. At least one public-source feasibility probe should run when possible; synthetic assumptions must remain explicit.
